items.artifact: compiled integrated manuscript and label/reference audit
expanded open module packet for G1
items.claim_boundary: This module is not yet a theorem. It is implemented as a precise construction target for a cutoff-indexed geometric collar.
items.promotion: Promote G1 only when the edge-list construction satisfies positive-time support, footprint locking, reflection pairing, and the stated joint scaling.
items.demotion: Keep G1 open if the collar collapse changes the footprint, exits the positive algebra, or depends on an unstated order of limits.

items.artifact: expanded open module packet for G2
items.claim_boundary: This module is implemented as a normalization audit and theorem target, not as a completed renormalization proof.
items.promotion: Promote G2 only when every removed factor is realized by congruence, direct normalized observables, or a proved positive-kernel factorization.
items.demotion: Demote the geometric route if it needs pair-dependent entrywise division without a positivity certificate.

items.artifact: expanded open module packet for G3
items.claim_boundary: This module is implemented as the exact coefficient-extraction workload for the geometric collar; no geometric H,K theorem is claimed yet.
items.promotion: Promote G3 only when \(H_k,K_k\) and the operator-norm remainder are derived from the same normalized geometric block.
items.demotion: Do not promote the source-amplitude \(H,K\) calculation as a geometric-collar coefficient theorem.

items.artifact: expanded open module packet for G4
items.claim_boundary: This module is implemented as a lower-bound programme for the reduced margins, not as a proved continuum lower bound.
items.promotion: Promote G4 only when lower bounds survive the chosen cutoff trajectory.
items.demotion: Keep strict-margin claims finite if \(\sigma_k\) or \(\tau_k\) may vanish as \(k\to\infty\).

items.artifact: expanded open module packet for E1
items.claim_boundary: This module is implemented as a same-regulator endpoint derivation target, not as an endpoint theorem.
items.promotion: Promote E1 only when the estimator is derived from the same geometric Wilson family and regulator.
items.demotion: Do not infer endpoint signs from an incidence ansatz not tied to the regulated path integral.

items.artifact: expanded open module packet for E2
items.claim_boundary: This module is implemented as the two-sided error architecture needed for endpoint certificates.
items.promotion: Promote E2 only with a same-regulator two-sided error bound.
items.demotion: A one-sided lower bound can certify positivity when \(M_G-U>0\), but cannot certify an obstruction.

items.artifact: expanded open module packet for M1
items.claim_boundary: This module is implemented as a reconstruction handoff checklist; it remains open.
items.promotion: Promote M1 only with an actual continuum construction or a theorem importing one in the same theory.
items.demotion: Finite reflection positivity must remain a necessary finite condition, not OS reconstruction.

items.artifact: expanded open module packet for M2

items.promotion: Promote M2 only after M1 and a non-circular same-theory spectral estimate.
